name: progress-bar
title: Progress Bar
description: A bar that springs to each new amount with a sheen along the fill, a counting percentage and a green finish.

perf.budget: Plain views and four shared values. The sheen loops on the UI thread only while work is under way; a finished bar is idle.

measurements.notes: The demo advances the bar every 0.9 s, so the sheen was running at rest; a finished bar draws nothing.

a11y.reducedMotion: The fill jumps to each value with no sheen; the indeterminate bar holds still.
a11y.screenReader: A progress bar named by its label with a 0 to 100 value, marked busy until it is done.
